summary: E2E frontend testing of new PFP Admin Dashboard at /admin (control plane + data plane). All 11 scenarios from review_request passed. Demo portal at '/' and '/verify' intact.

issues: Radix Dialog console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' — minor a11y improvement (add DialogDescription)

action_items: Optional: add <DialogDescription> to Tenants/ApiKeys Dialogs to silence Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Tenant ID generation uses slugified name (e.g. 'TEST_Acme_<ts>' -> 'test-acme-<ts>'); duplicate names could collide — server already enforces uniqueness (POST returns error toast), so acceptable.

ApiKeys.jsx auto-stores the just-created raw key in sessionStorage (tenantKeys.set) which is convenient for Proof Explorer hand-off, but the same module also revokes keys; ensure revoke flow clears the stored tenant key locally to avoid stale binding (currently it does not).
api.js: 401 interceptor force-redirects via window.location.href, bypassing React Router — works but causes full reload; acceptable for control-plane.
Overview StatCard labels use CSS uppercase transform; minor — accessible (innerText returns uppercased) but cosmetic-only.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST_ tenant (TEST_Acme_<timestamp>) and one TEST_ API key (revoked after creation). No cleanup performed — main agent may wish to add bulk delete or accept TEST_ prefixed leftovers.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin Dashboard at /admin is fully functional. All data-testids exist as documented. Verified flows: auth guard, wrong-password rejection, login, Overview (stats + System Health + Audit Chain Integrity=Intact + Recent Activity), Tenants create (visible in tenants-table), API Keys create (raw pfp_live_… shown via created-key-value, then visible as active in api-keys-table), API Key revoke (status flips to 'revoked'), Signing Keys list (signing-keys-table present), Audit Log (tenant.created/apikey.created/apikey.revoked entries present, verify-chain-btn returns 'Hash chain intact — 72 entries verified'), Proof Explorer with connect-sandbox (proofs-table loads with default tenant FEAs), Demo Portal '/' and '/verify' still render. The revoked production signing key was NOT touched.
rca of the issue: No issues observed; admin dashboard implementation matches spec end-to-end.
